newsitem.title: UK: BA staff reject offer on catering sale.
newsitem.headline: BA staff reject offer on catering sale.

text.p: The British union representing catering staff at British Airways Plc said on Thursday that members voted by a majority of 551 to 178 to reject the airline's proposal to sell off the catering division at London's Heathrow airport.
BA ground staff belonging to the T&G have been balloted since late on Wednesday on whether to accept or reject proposals to sell the airline's catering operation at London Heathrow.

"British Airways catering employees have clearly rejected management proposals and wish BA's catering operations to remain in-house," said George Ryde, the Transport and General Workers Union's (T&G) national secretary for aviation told Reuters.
The union said representatives of all ground staff would meet on Monday to decide how the dispute would progress.

The rejection came at the end of the second day of a strike by cabin crew against a newly-imposed pay structure and conditions which has grounded hundreds of flights and stranded thousands of passengers.
